title: Genuine owned token retains mutable contents
required_fix_or_preservation: Before content-attested execution claims, keep mutable record/buffer private and return protected derivatives, or explicitly narrow authority to issuance. Preserve original parser semantics.

title: input.digest collides on changed children and exposes root text
required_fix_or_preservation: Keep echo scope. An actual identity consumer must define byte/value/order/presence identity and disclosure policy before selecting a hash. No generic hash layer follows from this name.

title: Normalized decimal default is rejected by prepared copying
required_fix_or_preservation: If prepared completeness is required, copy validated immutable scalar carriers without losing coefficient/scale/-0 or identity policy; otherwise retain explicit abstention. Do not bypass provenance or claim native validation.

title: Duplicate exact entries select first natively, last after reconstruction
required_fix_or_preservation: Enforce declared unique-key admission before core guards, or choose/qualify common duplicate semantics. Existing hygiene contract supports rejection without new policy.

title: Astral diagnostic cut has different UTF16 units
required_fix_or_preservation: Keep explicit exclusion until an admitted diagnostic carrier preserves exact UTF16 or requirement changes. Error wrapper projection is separate.

title: Lone surrogate produces host codec error but native transport refusal
required_fix_or_preservation: Retain explicit lossless-string domain limit; broad parity would require owner-approved UTF16 carrier. No replacement U+FFFD or imaginary connected validator.

title: Opaque JSON preserves order rather than canonical bytes
required_fix_or_preservation: Qualify canonical shape vs bytes. Future hash consumer must declare byte identity or semantic/order identity; do not sort opaque JSON by inference.

title: Native codec violations disappear at backend projection
required_fix_or_preservation: For a selected native codec cut, qualify owning public projection of ordered violations; until then advertise raw native payload only.

title: CSV empty mapped cells collapse null/empty text into absence
required_fix_or_preservation: Make mapped empty-cell meaning type-directed; keep omission only for unmapped columns. Use owning decoder and ordinary constraints/defaults.
acceptance: Nullable blank maps null; required unconstrained text blank remains empty; unmapped optional/defaulted member stays absent; constrained empty text fails its constraint.

title: Unknown blank CSV headers evade closedness
required_fix_or_preservation: Validate mappings/header paths against writable schema before mapping rows; reject unknown/protected/overlapping paths. Avoid assignment loss for __proto__ using safe own-key construction.
acceptance: Blank unknown column rejects. A __proto__ unknown header also rejects rather than silently disappearing under assignment; duplicate/known blank behavior stays explicit.

title: CSV duplicates use raw numeric spelling rather than normalized values
required_fix_or_preservation: Canonicalize explicitly supplied typed candidate values through owner codec before duplicate comparison/consent; preserve explicit presence and protected versions. Do not bulk rehash receipts.
acceptance: -0/0 and 00/0 integer candidates duplicate after owner normalization; exact nonzero int64 values remain distinct. Separately qualify decimal scale equality and old receipt hash profiles.

title: Consent digest fails to bind row-index selections to frozen row inputs
required_fix_or_preservation: Bind reviewed row identity/index/status plus frozen normalized input to consent and selection, or store private immutable review state keyed by opaque ID. Revalidate exact selected input when CSV echo changes.
acceptance: A/B above require renewed review; adding malformed/unselected rows cannot redirect a selected replay key; identical frozen retry remains replayable. Version existing consent wire if format changes.

title: CSV commit follows caller array order instead of source order
required_fix_or_preservation: After validating uniqueness and consent, submit selections in source-row order while retaining per-row operation IDs and frozen inputs.
acceptance: Reversed selection wire executes row0 before row1; failure after a successful first row preserves its commit and remaining outcome order.
independent_scope_correction: UI collectCommitSelections sorts indexes; witness uses an admitted reordered direct JSON caller. Server ordering remains source-derived.

title: CSV consent has no team/session/expiry lifecycle
required_fix_or_preservation: Provide private user/app/team review lifecycle with 24h expiry and immediate invalidation on logout/context loss; choose owning persisted/opaque or integrity-protected review mechanism separately.
acceptance: Context changes/new login discard old review consent; expired review fails even with fresh IDs; receipts retain independent replay lifetime. Compatibility/version handling for current unsigned fields is required before transition.

title: HTTP/CSV age gate prevents otherwise retained receipt replay
required_fix_or_preservation: Keep transport UUID shape checks, move age enforcement for unseen identities behind receipt lookup at canonical owner. Preserve current authority/projection checks on replay.
acceptance: Same matching retained receipt replays through HTTP/CSV after24h; unseen old ID rejects; conflicting reuse conflicts rather than running again. Uppercase policy remains separate.

title: Provider diagnostic token/account text reaches public completion error
required_fix_or_preservation: Use safe adapter-owned explanations/classifications for untrusted free-text provider failures; disclose specificity only when a defined safe field/template establishes it. Expand case coverage as immediate regression but blacklist alone cannot certify account/body privacy.
acceptance: Both examples yield generic safe message, not supplied text. Known safe adapter-owned message remains actionable. Credential/stack/body/account negative cases cover all three consumers; grants still restrict admitted completion fields.
independent_scope_correction: Email 400 body actually reaches mapSendResponse via HttpStatusError catch/mapSendError. ComfyUI helper text instead goes to succeeded ModelImageResult.detail with state failed; adjacent result projection, not DeliveryError.message. Confidential provider-message context explicit; no installed binding or observed traffic established.

title: S256 authorization accepts challenges no exchange can satisfy
required_fix_or_preservation: Make authorize challenge admission match actual S256 output domain (43 chars with canonical unused tail bits); define verifier syntax gate under adopted OAuth profile. Retain exact redirect comparison; do not normalize bearer strings.
acceptance: 44/128-character challenge rejects before code issuance; legitimate43-character S256 challenge exchanges; malformed verifier fails generically. Existing unexchangeable code rows need expiry/disposition, not hash reinterpretation.
independent_scope_correction: 44-character producer/consumer disagreement is factual. Verifier syntax changes and persisted-input tightening require separate owner compatibility decision. Current PKCE mismatch leaves code unconsumed; do not infer consume-before-check.

title: Graph digest and JSON cloning use different unsupported-value domains
required_fix_or_preservation: Specify and enforce data-only JSON graph admission before digesting/cloning. Reject undefined/nonfinite/function/symbol/accessors/toJSON rather than silently altering settings. If owner intentionally permits wider host values, resolve preservation contract and clone accordingly. Version graph digest domain if changed.
acceptance: Unsafe extension rejected before reviewed digest acceptance; JSON graphs retain every unmapped setting; reviewed mapping digests stay compatible or get explicit review/version transition.

title: f64 precision, negative zero, count width
required_fix_or_preservation: Keep f64 until owning JSON sink and its normalization; reject fixed-width overflow at declared transport range before coercion. Safe-integer tightening needs a separate migration.

title: alias identity and cloning
required_fix_or_preservation: Preserve Work safety-before-clone versus State clone-only. Retain alias facts or leave clone in host; no universal JSON normalization.
independent_scope_correction: State helper clones true cycles, but later JSON durable sink refuses them; no persisted-cycle acceptance claimed.

title: receipt missing/null and predicate versus persistence
required_fix_or_preservation: Retain property presence and current safety/error point; do not combine completion consistency with persistence safety or omit undefined before admission.
independent_scope_correction: ReceiptRowData TypeScript interface requires result. Omitted-result witness is an arbitrary-JS helper input, not a valid typed producer obligation.

title: duplicate claim resolution and resulting action
required_fix_or_preservation: Preserve last-wins order; no new duplicate policy. Retain fenced staleness/completion/reconcile checks when executing release.

title: cursor missing/null versus empty UTF16 text
required_fix_or_preservation: Retain explicit presence/null, UTF16, over-delivery check and exact capped-drain resume. Never infer done from truthiness/empty rows.

title: callback demand order versus sorted outputs
required_fix_or_preservation: Keep host demand/throw position. Pure extraction consumes only already-demanded branch facts; no eager generic DTO. Executor rereads live evidence.

title: redundant numeric bits and rendering spelling
required_fix_or_preservation: Enforce coherent producer provenance or validate/rederive approved canonical spelling before bridge adoption; naive Number(spelling) equality is wrong. Preserve -0/nonfinite.

title: duplicate keys, key order and canonical digest
required_fix_or_preservation: Enforce unique-key provenance/reject foreign duplicates. For general digest reproduce JS numeric-index order, or qualify proven prefixed-only domain. Preserve own __proto__/metadata.

title: frame cap versus conversion/allocation order
required_fix_or_preservation: Incrementally bound framing before copying unbounded chunk; account separately for JSON/UTF8/job budgets. No measured OOM claim or new public language limit.

title: reviewed metadata versus actual published bytes
required_fix_or_preservation: Read/check actual buffer and submit that same validated snapshot. Check exact key set and duplicates; current loop checks staged-only and Map collapses reviewed duplicates. Preserve partial-write/preview behavior.

title: UTF16 identity versus UTF8 published-byte identity
required_fix_or_preservation: Retain digest version and exact submitted bytes. Path-domain tightening needs explicit decision; do not silently normalize/reject strings. Hashes prove neither privacy nor admission.

title: module-map absence, own undefined and positional identity
required_fix_or_preservation: Keep composed map with rewritten JS and exact presence/index semantics; preserve invalid-map behavior. No native rewrite/map substitute without same-output caller proof.
acceptance: P05.1/P05.5 and owning module-map tests

title: Form decoding drops an own input key that JSON preserves
required_fix_or_preservation: Preserve own encoded keys through parsing and coercion using an existing safe construction primitive, or explicitly reject a disallowed key before conversion. Do not introduce a generic bridge.
acceptance: JSON/form key-presence comparison, last duplicate wins, __proto__/constructor/prototype controls, body caps and existing error ordering.

title: Collection filter passthrough silently drops __proto__
required_fix_or_preservation: Preserve own filter keys or refuse explicitly before conversion, alongside DP01. Qualify the real query consumer before claiming an end-to-end unknown-field rejection fix.
acceptance: Own special keys reach the declared validator or explicit refusal; absence, empty text, repeated filter keys and safe integer limits retain their current distinctions.
